title: Juicy Apple
summary: Eating this poisoned apple gives Upset Stomach and can lead to escalating illness.

fields.Eat: Consumes one apple. The Wetlands source reports a Poisoned-group effect for 10 turns. Its named condition is Upset Stomach.
fields.Upset Stomach: When it ends, make a DC 15 Constitution save. Failure causes Feverish for 25 turns.
fields.Feverish: Disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws. When it ends, another DC 15 Constitution save prevents Filth Fever.
fields.Acquisition: Found in the Sunlit Wetlands while the illusion is intact. The item appears as Poisoned Apple after the illusion is dispelled.
fields.Filth Fever: For 25 turns, gain disadvantage on attack rolls and on Strength checks and saving throws. At expiry, a DC 15 Constitution save prevents the condition from reapplying.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
